text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and C above my average cost felt rewarding, but gains alone are not a reliable reason to sell; I should weigh each position against my overall plan.","My account value can fall even after rising, as Period 4 reminded me; I should expect short-term volatility without assuming it predicts what comes next.","With prices moving randomly, I should avoid treating recent performance as a forecast and make future buy, sell, or hold decisions based on risk and diversification."]}
